ShortDescription.Value: Create, connect and modify medians along roads in intersections and at transit stops.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Median Controller --------------------- # !!Closed Beta Version!! # !!Expect Bugs and possible crashes; report any on discord channel!!
# Features
- Connect median endpoints through intersections, including medians with different widths. - Edit road medians with Rounded or Straight end caps. - Modify center median to be Grass or Pavement regardless of transit stop precence. - Draw custom polygon medians using an existing median's style, with lane, road-marking and median-corner snapping. - Select and edit created polygon medians, including their surface, curb width, offsets and corner rounding. - Keep median edits and custom polygons when saving and reloading your city.
# Compatiblity Tested working with: - Road Builder - Traffic
Currently no incompatible mods have been reported/found.
Paradox Forum and Source Code to be Linked upon public release.
